name: Lightware LW3

actions.name: XP:Switch - Select video input for output

options.label: Input
options.choicesNote: Runtime list built from the device port names: ids are port strings such as "I1" (read from /MEDIA/VIDEO/*.Text on GENERAL devices or /MEDIA/NAMES/VIDEO.* on MX2 devices), label = port name. Default in the source: id of the first port, or an empty string while the list is empty.

options.label: Output
options.choicesNote: Runtime list built from the device port names: ids are port strings such as "O1" (see Input), label = port name. Default in the source: id of the first port, or an empty string while the list is empty.

options.label: Preset
options.choicesNote: Runtime list read from the device: GENERAL devices and MX2 devices with /PRESETS/AVC use the preset id and name from "/PRESETS/AVC/<id>.Name=<name>"; MX2 devices without it fall back to the ids found under /MEDIA/PRESET (label = id). Default in the source: id of the first preset, or an empty string.

options.label: Source
options.choicesNote: Runtime list built from the device port names: ids are port strings such as "I1" (read from /MEDIA/VIDEO/*.Text on GENERAL devices or /MEDIA/NAMES/VIDEO.* on MX2 devices), label = port name. Default in the source: id of the first port, or an empty string while the list is empty.

options.label: Destination
options.choicesNote: Runtime list built from the device port names: ids are port strings such as "O1" (see Input), label = port name. Default in the source: id of the first port, or an empty string while the list is empty.

actions.name: Route selected ports
actions.description: Routes the source and destination chosen with selectSource / selectDestination; does nothing unless they match /^I\d+$/ and /^O\d+$/.

actions.name: Output Lock

options.label: Output
options.description: max is the device value XP.DestinationPortCount, read at runtime.

actions.availability: Added only when the device answers the probe for /MEDIA/VIDEO/XP.* containing XP:lockDestination; the action becomes visible after the next definition rebuild (initActions).

actions.name: Switch USB Host

options.label: Host
options.choicesNote: Choice "0" (Off) is fixed; further string ids are the host numbers found in the device properties /MEDIA/USB/USBSWITCH.Enable<n>, with label "PC <n>".

actions.availability: Added only when the device answers the probe for /MEDIA/USB/USBSWITCH.* containing Enable<n>=; the action becomes visible after the next definition rebuild (initActions).

actions.name: Run Macro

options.label: Macro
options.choicesNote: Runtime list: macro names (last field of /CTRL/MACROS.<n>=<..>;<..>;<name>); when none are found the single entry "No macros available" (id and label) is listed, which the callback ignores. Default is the first entry.

actions.availability: Added only when the device answers the probe for /CTRL/MACROS.* containing MACROS.<n>=; the action becomes visible after the next definition rebuild (initActions).

feedbacks.name: Route
feedbacks.description: Shows if an input is routed to an output

options.label: Input
options.description: Tooltip in the source: 0 = selected (the input chosen with selectSource).

options.label: Output
options.description: Tooltip in the source: 0 = selected (the destination chosen with selectDestination).

feedbacks.name: source selected
feedbacks.description: Shows if an input is selected for routing

feedbacks.name: destination selected
feedbacks.description: Shows if an output is selected for routing

notes: Complete list: 9 actions (6 always registered in initActions, 3 conditional ones added in initDevice: outputLock, switchUSB, runMacro) and 3 boolean feedbacks (initFeedbacks). All in index.js.

Protocol: Lightware LW3 over a TCP socket on fixed port 6107 (TCPHelper, host from config "Device IP"). Two device families are handled: GENERAL (OPTC-TX/RX, MMX NxN, UMX-TPS, MEX, HDMI-TPS-TX/RX200, HDMI-3D-OPT, SW4-OPT, MODEX) and MX2 (product name starting with "MX2"); unknown products are treated as GENERAL but initialised like MX2. Crosspoints use "CALL /MEDIA/VIDEO/XP:switch(<in>:<out>)" (GENERAL) or "CALL /MEDIA/XP/VIDEO:switch(<in>:<out>)" (MX2).

Port dropdown ids are strings such as "I1" / "O1" taken from the device (the actions) while the feedbacks use plain port numbers (1..512, the module prefixes "I"/"O" itself). Preset and USB-host ids are strings too.

The conditional actions are stored in this.actions during initDevice and only reach Companion at the next initActions() call (names / presets arriving); the catalog records them with an availability note.
Presets (selection and take buttons per port, "Take selected") and variables (name_<port>, source_<port>, sourcename_<port>) are not catalogued.
Built on @companion-module/base ~1.4.1: options do not support expressions.
